4802.grammar: ger of na upādiyati, irreg form of na upādāya, neg, trans (+acc)
4802.meaning1: not holding (on); not grasping (on); detaching; without clinging; not taking possession (of)
4802.construction:
na > an + upa + √ādā + ya
na + upādāya > anupādā

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā. ye suvimuttā, te kevalino. ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.
bhūtam'idan'ti, bhante, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati. bhūtam'idan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā bhūtassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti.

4803.meaning1: non-agitation through non-clinging; non-anxiety through non-attachment

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, anupādā-aparitassanā hoti? idha, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.

4804.meaning1: unattached; with no attachment; not clinging; without grasping; not taking possession (of)

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ iñjitapaccayā, tasmā hi ejaṃ vossajja, saṅkhāre uparundhiya, anejo anupādāno, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
pāragū anupādāno, katakicco anāsavo, tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti, mutto āghātanā yathā.
seyyathā'pi, vaccha, aggi saupādāno jalati, no anupādāno, evam'eva khv'āhaṃ, vaccha, saupādānassa upapattiṃ paññāpemi, no anupādānassā'ti.

4806.grammar: nt, act, from na upādiyati, neg
4806.meaning1: non-acquiring; non-appropriating; not taking possession; not grasping; non-clinging; non-identification

examples.text: ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, atthi sabbaso bhavanirodho'ti, tesam'ayaṃ diṭṭhi asārāgāya santike, asaṃyogāya santike, anabhinandanāya santike, anajjhosānāya santike, anupādānāya santike'ti.

4807.meaning1: (abhi) ungraspable; not to be clung to; which cannot be used for fuel
4807.meaning2: which can not be grasped; which could not be clung to; which can not be used for fuel

examples.text: upādinn'upādāniyā dhammā. anupādinn'upādāniyā dhammā. anupādinna-anupādāniyā dhammā.

4808.meaning1: complete extinguishing though not grasping; total dousing by detaching; completely going out without fuel; (comm) absolute quenching without condition
4808.commentary: (MNa) anupādāparinibbānaṃ nāma appaccayaparinibbānaṃ. dvedhā upādānāni gahaṇ'ūpādānañ'ca paccay'ūpādānañ'ca. gahaṇ'ūpādānaṃ nāma kām'upādān'ādikaṃ catubbidhaṃ, paccay'ūpādānaṃ nāma avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā'ti evaṃ vuttapaccayā.

examples.text: kim'atthaṃ carah'āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? anupādāparinibbān'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.
kiṃ pan'āvuso, aññatra imehi dhammehi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

4809.meaning1: for the sake of complete extinguishing though not grasping; for the purpose of total dousing by detaching; (comm) for the sake of absolute quenching without condition
4809.commentary: (MNa) anupādāparinibbānaṃ nāma appaccayaparinibbānaṃ. dvedhā upādānāni gahaṇ'ūpādānañ'ca paccay'ūpādānañ'ca. gahaṇ'ūpādānaṃ nāma kām'upādān'ādikaṃ catubbidhaṃ, paccay'ūpādānaṃ nāma avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā'ti evaṃ vuttapaccayā.

examples.text: kim'atthaṃ carah'āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? anupādāparinibbān'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.
evam'eva kho, āvuso… ñāṇadassanavisuddhi yāva'd'eva anupādāparinibbān'atthā. anupādāparinibbān'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.

4810.meaningLit: discourse on complete extinguishing though not grasping

4811.grammar: ger of na upādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
4811.meaning1: not holding (onto); not grasping (onto); detaching (from); not taking possession (of)
4811.construction:
na > an + upa + √ādā + ya
an + upādāya

examples.text: yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.
ajj'eva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarasve vā'ti

4812.commentary: (MNa) anupādā vimutto'ti catūhi upādānehi kañci dhammaṃ anupādiyitvā vimutto.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbajī hoti.

4813.meaning1: deliverance through detaching; emancipation by not grasping
4813.commentary: (MNa) ettha saṅkhārapaṭikkhepena nibbānaṃ dassitaṃ. imasmiṃ pana sutte chaāyatanapaṭikkhepena dassitaṃ. aññattha ca anupādāvimokkho'ti nibbānam'eva dassitaṃ, idha pana arahattaphalasamāpatti.

examples.text: idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ yadidaṃ, channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimokkho.

4814.meaning2: not evolved or derived, primary; not evolved by the influence of kamma; inanimate

4815.meaning1: not grasped; not clung to; not attached to; not taken as mine; not taken possession (of)

examples.text: so viññāṇaṃ na upeti, na upādiyati, n'ādhiṭṭhāti, attā me'ti. tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā anupetā anupādinnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī'ti.
upādinn'upādāniyā dhammā. anupādinn'upādāniyā dhammā. anupādinn'ānupādāniyā dhammā.

4817.grammar: prp of na upādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
4817.meaning1: not attaching (to); not taking as mine; not grasping (onto); not clinging (to); not taking possession (of)
4817.commentary: (ANa) anupādiyaṃ na paritassatī'ti aggaṇhanto taṇhāparitassanāya na paritassati.

examples.text: so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
katamā c'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu ye loke upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, te pajahanto viharati anupādiyanto. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.

4818.grammar: prp of na upādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
4818.meaning1: not attaching (to); not taking as mine; not grasping (onto); not clinging (to)

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto vihareyyan'ti. upādiyamāno kho, bhikkhu, baddho mārassa, anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato'ti.

4819.grammar: prp of na upādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
4819.meaning1: not attaching (to); not taking as mine; not grasping (onto); not clinging (to); not taking possession (of)

examples.text: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
pucchāmi taṃ ādiccabandhu, vivekaṃ santipadañ'ca mahesi, kathaṃ disvā nibbāti bhikkhu, anupādiyāno lokasmiṃ kiñci.

4820.meaning1: with no grasping; with no residual clinging; with no fuel remaining
4820.commentary: (ITIa) upādi'y'eva seso'ti upādiseso, saha upādisesenā'ti saupādisesā, tadabhāvato anupādisesā

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bahū ce'pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
ettāvat'aggam'pi vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, tesaṃ pan'eke samayaṃ vadanti, anupādisese kusalā vadānā.

4821.meaning1: with no residue remaining; with nothing left over

examples.text: anupādiseso'ti jānamāno so evaṃ vadeyya, ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso. analañ'ca te antarāyāya.
chaṭṭhena rathavinītena sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya, sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya. sattamena rathavinītena sāketaṃ anupāpuṇeyya antepuradvāraṃ.

atha ca pana me imaṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ'ca cittaṃ samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāmī'ti.

4823.synonym: appeti, āpajjati, pappoti, pāpuṇāti, phusati, phuseti, phussayati

examples.text: atthi nu kho, bhante ānanda, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato avimuttañ'c'eva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī'ti?

4826.meaning1: having reached; having attained; having achieved
4826.synonym: adhigantvā, pāpuṇitvā, pāpuṇitvāna, phassayitvā, phassitvā, phusayitvā, phusitvā, phussayitvā, sampatvā

examples.text: taṃ tvaṃ sāmaññ'atthaṃ anupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyā'ti.

4827.meaning2: causes (or makes one) to conduct or lead

examples.text: diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho, sammāpaṭipadā. tasmā eso dhammo araṇo.

4832.meaning1: mostly untroubled; unafflicted most of the time

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno akkodhano ahosi anupāyāsabahulo, bahum'pi vutto samāno n'ābhisajji na kuppi na byāpajji na patitthīyi, na kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.

4833.commentary: (DHPa) chāyā'va anapāyinī'ti yathā hi chāyā nāma sarīrappaṭibaddhā sarīre gacchante gacchati, tiṭṭhante tiṭṭhati, nisīdante nisīdati, na sakkoti, saṇhena vā pharusena vā nivattāhī'ti vatvā vā pothetvā vā nivattāpetuṃ. kasmā? sarīrappaṭibaddhattā. evam'eva imesaṃ dasannaṃ kusalakammapathānaṃ āciṇṇasamāciṇṇakusalamūlikaṃ kāmāvacarādibhedaṃ kāyikacetasikasukhaṃ gatagataṭṭhāne anapāyinī chāyā viya hutvā na vijahatī'ti.

examples.text: antaken'ādhipannassa, jahato mānusaṃ bhavaṃ, kiñ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, kiñ'ca ādāya gacchati, kiñ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anupāyinī.

4834.meaning1: without a fault-finding mind; without a critical attitude

examples.text: so anupārambhacitto samāno bhabbo muṭṭhassaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.

4840.meaning2: who is not a female lay-disciple

4841.meaning1: not attended; not served; not followed
4841.commentary: (THIa) sattā vā anusāsito siyā'ti sattā vā dhammasarīrassa adassanena yassā itthiyā ananusāsito siyā.

examples.text: yassā siyā apaccavekkhitaṃ, satthā vā anupāsito siyā, tvaṃ tādisikaṃ palobhaya, jānantiṃ so imaṃ vihaññasi.
yathā kaṇṭakaṭṭhānamhi, careyya anupāhano, satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvāna, evaṃ gāme munī care.

4846.construction:
anu + √pī > piy + a + ā
anupiya + ā

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, atippago kho tāva anupiyāyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena bhaggavagottassa paribbājakassa ārāmo, yena bhaggavagotto paribbājako ten'upasaṅkameyyan'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā anupiyāyaṃ viharati ambavane.
vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakka-anupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.
diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.

4851.commentary: (ITIa) anupubbenā'ti sīl'ādivisuddhipaṭipāṭiyā, tattha ca vipassanāpaṭipāṭiyā c'eva maggapaṭipāṭiyā ca.

examples.text: mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro, na āyataken'eva papāto
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.

so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati. yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti yug'ādhāne.

4853.meaning1: gradual undertaking; step-by-step activity; successive process
4853.commentary: (UDa) anupubbasikkhāya tisso bhikkhā gahitā, anupubbakiriyāya terasa dhut'aṅgadhammā, anupubbapaṭipadāya satta anupassanā aṭṭhārasa mahāvipassanā aṭṭhatiṃsa ārammaṇavibhattiyo sattatiṃsa bodhipakkhiyadhammā ca gahitā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.
evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho
iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā pada-anupubbatā-apetaṃ, iccā'ti.
nava anupubbanirodhā. paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti.

4858.meaning1: gradual progress; step-by-step path of practice
4858.commentary: (UDa) anupubbasikkhāya tisso bhikkhā gahitā, anupubbakiriyāya terasa dhut'aṅgadhammā, anupubbapaṭipadāya satta anupassanā aṭṭhārasa mahāvipassanā aṭṭhatiṃsa ārammaṇavibhattiyo sattatiṃsa bodhipakkhiyadhammā ca gahitā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.
evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho
taṃ kammaṃ katvā kusalaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ, jaṅghā manuññā labhate susaṇṭhitā, vaṭṭā sujātā anupubbam'uggatā, uddh'aggalomā sukhumattac'otthatā.

4861.meaning1: gradual (stilling of) mental activity; step-by-step (ending of) thought processes

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti, doso niruddho hoti, moho niruddho hoti. atha kho, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto. paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti.

4862.commentary: (ANt) navannaṃ anupubbasamāpattīnan'ti paṭhamajjhāna-samāpatti'ādīnaṃ navannaṃ anupubbasamāpattīnaṃ. ettha ca paṭipāṭiyā aṭṭhannaṃ samādhī'ti'pi nāmaṃ, samāpattī'ti'pi cittek'aggatāsabbhāvato, nirodhasamāpattiyā tadabhāvato na samādhī'ti nāmaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.
evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho

4864.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of anupubba
4864.meaning1: in sequential order; one after the next

examples.text: devakāyā abhikkantā, te vijānātha bhikkhavo, ye vo'haṃ kittayissāmi, girāhi anupubbaso.

4865.meaning1: successive stage of meditation; progressive level of attainment

examples.text: nava anupubbavihārā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

4866.meaning1: attainment of the successive stages in meditation
4866.commentary: (NIDD1a) navannaṃ anupubbavihāra-samāpattīnan'ti pubbaṃ pubbaṃ anu anupubbaṃ, anupubbaṃ viharitabbato samāpajjitabbato anupubbavihāra-samāpatti, anupaṭipāṭiyā samāpajjitabbā'ti attho, tāsaṃ navannaṃ anupubbavihāra-samāpattīnaṃ.

examples.text: (navannaṃ anupubbavihāra-samāpattīnaṃ pañcannañ'ca abhiññānaṃ evaṃ vitthāro veditabbo.)

4869.meaning1: dwelling in ever-higher meditation attainments; experiencing successive levels of accomplishment
4869.commentary: (UDa) anupubbavihāri tattha so'ti evaṃ tīsu'pi kālesu att'attaniyaṃ suññataṃ tattha saṅkhāragate anupassanto anukkamena udayabbayañāṇ'ādi-vipassanāñāṇesu uppajjamānesu anupubbavipassanā-vihāra-vasena anupubbavihārī samāno.

examples.text: yassa siyā sabbadā sati, satataṃ kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, no c'assa no ca me siyā, na bhavissati na ca me bhavissati, anupubbavihāri tattha so, kālen'eva tare visattikan'ti.

4870.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anupubba

examples.text: kaṅkhī vecikicchī āgamaṃ, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāhi pañhe me puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākarohi me.
accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.

4871.meaning1: gradual total cessation of consciousness; step by step ending of perception
4871.meaning2: gradual total cessation of consciousness; ultimate step by step ending of perception
4871.commentary: (DNa) anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpattin'ti ettha abhī'ti upasaggamattaṃ, sampajānapadaṃ nirodhapadena antarikaṃ katvā vuttaṃ. anupaṭipāṭiyā sampajāna-saññānirodha-samāpattī'ti ayaṃ pan'etth'attho. tatrā'pi sampajāna-saññānirodha-samāpattī'ti sampajānantassa ante saññā nirodhasamāpatti sampajānantassa vā paṇḍitassa bhikkhuno saññānirodhasamāpattī'ti ayaṃ visesattho.

examples.text: so nirodhaṃ phusati. evaṃ kho, poṭṭhapāda, anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpatti hoti.

4872.meaning1: attainment of the gradual total cessation of consciousness while clearly aware
4872.commentary: (DNa) anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpattin'ti ettha abhī'ti upasaggamattaṃ, sampajānapadaṃ nirodhapadena antarikaṃ katvā vuttaṃ. anupaṭipāṭiyā sampajāna-saññānirodha-samāpattī'ti ayaṃ pan'etth'attho. tatrā'pi sampajāna-saññānirodha-samāpattī'ti sampajānantassa ante saññā nirodhasamāpatti sampajānantassa vā paṇḍitassa bhikkhuno saññānirodhasamāpattī'ti ayaṃ visesattho.
4872.sanskrit: anupūrva + abhi + saṃjñā + nirodha + samprajāna + samāpatti

examples.text: so nirodhaṃ phusati. evaṃ kho, poṭṭhapāda, anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpatti hoti.

4873.meaning1: talk that develops progressively; graduated instruction; systematic talk
4873.commentary: (ANa) anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathessāmī'ti dān'ānantaraṃ sīlaṃ, sīl'ānantaraṃ saggan'ti evaṃ desan'ānupubbiṃ kathaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ suttapadaṃ vā gāthāpadaṃ vā nikkhittaṃ hoti, tassa tassa anurūpakathaṃ kathessāmī'ti cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā upālissa gahapatissa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pannarasame, susāne seyyaṃ kappemī'ti etth'āyaṃ anupubbikathā.

anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathessāmī'ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
